**AWS S3:**
```
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket <bucket> --lifecycle-configuration file://lenny-lifecycle.json
```

**GCP Cloud Storage:**
```
gcloud storage buckets update gs://<bucket> --lifecycle-file=lenny-lifecycle.json
```

Azure Blob versioning and lifecycle management are configured through Storage
Account policies, and the control plane reads none of them.
